source_scope_limit: The OWR introduction uses smooth subvarieties of complex projective manifolds; its problem contextualizes higher codimension. The singular-ambient codimension-one example does not resolve that intended problem.
historical_scope: All scholarly retrieval, inspection, rendering and public metadata checks describe the original proof review or independent audit. Edition preparation rehashed frozen files for integrity without inspecting source bodies anew.
